name: RC-B10-0520/2026 - Après le § 4 - Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: 4a. Expresses, in this regard, its support for the Radegonda Project and for Milan’s candidacy to host the new UN pillar dedicated to the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI, as reflected in its public commitment; welcomes, furthermore, the broad civic and cross-sectoral nature of the initiative, bringing together a diverse ecosystem of institutional stakeholders, universities and business associations;
